intro: This page covers CLT’s official Hourly Deck, Daily Decks, Daily North Lot, Long Term Lots 1 and 2, the two Express Decks, and Valet, with rates copied from the official CLT parking pages on November 22, 2026. Several official products — Long Term Lot 1 ($14 cap), the Daily Decks, and both Express Decks — are sold only online, so a drive-up traveler on a busy day is often looking at Long Term Lot 2, Daily North, or the Hourly Deck. Below the official lots are eight off-airport options: The Parking Spot on Wilkinson Blvd and seven nearby hotels whose own pages describe a park-and-fly or parking package. Off-airport choices at CLT are fewer than at most big hubs; we included only operators that publish a street address and parking details on their own pages, so this is a sample, not every lot near the airport. Hotel shuttle hours vary a lot, so check before an early or late flight. Rates are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

listings.name: The Parking Spot Charlotte (CLT)
listings.area: Off US-74 (Wilkinson Blvd) near I-485, across from the airport’s economy parking; 0.6 miles to the airport per the operator

hours.notes: The operator’s Charlotte page does not publish lot hours or shuttle hours.

listings.shuttle: The shuttle picks you up at your vehicle and helps with luggage, per the operator. The Charlotte page does not publish shuttle hours or frequency.
offers: Premium covered (9'6" clearance; first drop-off on return)
listings.visitNotes: Take the US 74/29 Andrew Jackson Hwy exit from I-485; the lot is on the north side of the road. Entry is by scanning the QR code from your reservation. The page says you can change a reservation up to 1 hour before check-in.
listings.feeNotes: The operator’s page title says Charlotte rates start from $10.95/day (as listed on 2026-11-22); your price depends on dates in the reservation tool.
